args: Go to http://127.0.0.1:4790/login. Sign in with username {{amber_user}} and password {{amber_password}} with Stay logged in ticked, then verify the home page greets Amber Demo. Open the project Kitchen renovation and mark the task Choose worktop as done with its checkbox. Reload the page, then verify Choose worktop is no longer in the list of open tasks and Order tiles still is.
oneLiner: Marking “Choose worktop” complete is rejected, so it remains an open task after reload.
summary:
The server rejects the request used to mark the task as done, stating that this change is not supported by the capsule.
Enable task-status updates in the AMBER capsule, then rerun the task-completion flow.
